V-T-002.verification: Fuzzing tests for input validation (AFL, Peach, Radamsa)

V-T-004.verification: Code review for buffer overflow vulnerabilities

V-T-005.verification: Verify malware protection mechanism is active (code signing verification, whitelist check, or AV scan)

V-T-006.verification: Inspect and document physical cable routing protection (duct, conduit, armoring) — photo evidence required

V-T-007.verification: Verify end-to-end integrity on safety-relevant data flows (HMAC or signature test under attack simulation)

V-T-FSAFE-001.verification: Test fail-safe output state under simulated attack or communication loss — verify defined safe state is reached

V-T-008.verification: Concurrency and race testing of shared-memory access — verify atomicity and TOCTOU safety under simultaneous multi-master access (stress and interleaving)

V-T-009.verification: Verify the integrity check and replay protection on the sensor data path

V-T-011.verification: Verify command integrity and replay protection

V-T-012.verification: Test that interlocks reject out-of-range or unsafe commands
